name: M-Affan01 No-code Form Builder
free_limit: MIT-licensed client-side form builder with drag-and-drop fields, live preview, JSON form schemas, HTML/CSS/JS export, and browser-local submission storage; no software usage quota or expiry published.
watch_out: This is a local browser-based form designer, NOT a hosted form submission service. Responses and drafts are stored in browser localStorage; public collection, shared storage, hosting and backend delivery require separately provided infrastructure. README installation clone URL contains a placeholder; use the actual upstream repository URL.
